name: Aena S.M.E., S.A.
summary: Aena S.M.E., S.A., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the management of airports in Spain, Brazil, the United Kingdom, Mexico, and Colombia. The company operates through Airports, Real Estate Services, Región de Murcia International Airport, and International segments. It also manages commercial spaces in airport terminals, and a network of car parks; and leasing or transfer use of land, office buildings, warehouses, hangars, and cargo vessels to airlines, air cargo operators, handling agents and other airport service providers.
